premises.text: Large buyers lack usable information on suppliers' environmental sustainability while stakeholders increasingly demand it
premises.evidence_span: they don't have almost any information on their supplier's environmental sustainability

premises.text: Buyers enroll suppliers and collect sustainability scorecards through the platform
premises.evidence_span: sign up for supply shift, enroll your suppliers, and release your first questionnaire

premises.text: Buyers can drill into supplier risk dimensions such as regional water pollution on the fly
premises.evidence_span: drill down and look at which suppliers are in the region, which suppliers have high water pollution

premises.text: Suppliers see peer benchmarks and buyers can compare anonymous outside-network scores, incentivizing improvement and switching to greener suppliers
premises.evidence_span: Spacely Sprockets can see where it stands relative to its industry peers

premises.text: A unified scorecard library reduces RFP fatigue so suppliers answer once across buyers
premises.evidence_span: unified scorecard library that fixes the RFP fatigue problem

premises.text: Suppliers pay an annual fee plus a small per-supplier fee once enrolled
premises.evidence_span: once suppliers enroll, they pay a annual fee plus a small fee per supplier

value.text: Companies understand and manage supply-chain sustainability risk and choose greener suppliers without scandal headlines
value.evidence_span: helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk, and drive their suppliers to be better
